name: Chikan ~Shoujo wa Etsuraku-yuki no Densha ni Notte~
original_name: 恥感～少女は悦楽行きの電車に乗って～
source:
Shiori is just a quiet girl. One day, someone gropes around her body in the train.

She wants to stop it, but can't say anything, just standing.

However, she gradually gets addicted to his techniques as time passes...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
Shiori只是一个安静的女孩。有一天，有人在火车上摸索她的身体。

她想阻止，却什么也说不出来，只是站着。

然而，随着时间的推移，她渐渐沉迷于他的技巧……

[来自工口游戏商店]
